public_rationale: There is insufficient evidence to verify adequate Spanish comprehension alongside incorrect belief tracking in Leivada's interaction. The broader inference that the contemporary system lacked robust transfer of false-belief reasoning also remains unresolved. Assessing that inference requires controlled variations beyond a single answer.
limitations: The packet supplies no independently accessible Spanish transcript or qualifying replication.
The model identity, preceding conversation and exact test date remain unverified.
Without the interaction, linguistic misunderstanding and task ambiguity cannot be assessed.
A single incorrect answer would not establish the complete absence of theory-of-mind capacity.

The interaction occurred before publication, but the supplied context gives no exact test date. The target interval therefore has an unknown start and ends on February 17, 2023.
The Spanish test identifies the observation being assessed; it is not an antecedent of a conditional forecast.
